<documents>
<document id="travel-blocked-regions">
Countriesˆwhereˆcardsˆdon'tˆworkˆTallowbrookˆcardsˆdon'tˆworkˆinˆcomprehensivelyˆsanctionedˆcountriesˆandˆregions.ˆPurchases,ˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆandˆonlineˆordersˆfromˆmerchantsˆbasedˆthereˆareˆdeclined.ˆ##ˆWhyˆUSˆbanksˆandˆcardˆprogramsˆmustˆfollowˆUSˆsanctionsˆrules.ˆWeˆcan'tˆmakeˆexceptions,ˆandˆsupportˆcan'tˆunblockˆaˆsanctionedˆlocationˆforˆyou.ˆ##ˆSigningˆinˆfromˆabroadˆYouˆcanˆusuallyˆuseˆtheˆappˆfromˆanywhere,ˆbutˆaccessˆfromˆaˆsanctionedˆlocationˆmayˆbeˆblockedˆandˆcouldˆleadˆtoˆaˆreviewˆofˆyourˆaccount.ˆ##ˆDeclinedˆsomewhereˆelse?ˆIfˆyou'reˆinˆaˆcountryˆthatˆisn'tˆsanctionedˆandˆyourˆcardˆisˆdeclined,ˆtheˆcauseˆisˆmoreˆlikelyˆaˆfraudˆcheck,ˆyourˆcardˆcontrols,ˆorˆyourˆbalance.ˆSeeˆ"Whyˆwasˆmyˆcardˆdeclined?".ˆ##ˆSendingˆmoneyˆabroadˆInternationalˆwiresˆtoˆsanctionedˆcountriesˆareˆalsoˆblocked.ˆWiresˆtoˆotherˆcountriesˆmayˆstillˆbeˆreviewedˆbeforeˆthey'reˆsent.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="products-under-18">
Accountsˆforˆunder-18sˆTallowbrookˆaccountsˆareˆforˆpeopleˆagedˆ18ˆandˆover.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆteenˆaccounts,ˆcustodialˆaccountsˆorˆaccountsˆforˆchildren.ˆ##ˆSendingˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆyoungˆpersonˆIfˆyourˆchildˆhasˆanˆaccountˆatˆanotherˆbank,ˆyouˆcanˆsendˆmoneyˆthereˆbyˆACH.ˆ##ˆAddingˆaˆchildˆtoˆyourˆaccountˆYouˆcan'tˆaddˆaˆchildˆasˆanˆauthorizedˆuserˆorˆgiveˆthemˆaˆcardˆonˆyourˆaccount.ˆ##ˆWhenˆtheyˆturnˆ18ˆTheyˆcanˆapplyˆforˆtheirˆownˆaccountˆinˆtheˆappˆwithˆtheirˆownˆIDˆandˆSocialˆSecurityˆnumberˆorˆITIN.ˆ##ˆUsingˆaˆparent'sˆaccountˆPleaseˆdon'tˆletˆsomeoneˆelseˆuseˆyourˆcardˆorˆapp.ˆTransactionsˆmadeˆbyˆsomeoneˆyouˆgaveˆyourˆcardˆtoˆaren'tˆcoveredˆasˆunauthorized.ˆ##ˆStudentsˆStudentsˆagedˆ18ˆandˆoverˆcanˆopenˆanˆaccountˆlikeˆanyoneˆelse.ˆ##ˆGiftsˆforˆaˆchildˆWeˆcan'tˆholdˆmoneyˆonˆaˆchild'sˆbehalf.ˆIfˆyouˆwantˆtoˆsaveˆforˆaˆchild,ˆyouˆcanˆcreateˆaˆSavingsˆPocketˆinˆyourˆownˆaccountˆandˆnameˆitˆafterˆthem.ˆTheˆmoneyˆstaysˆyours.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="products-joint-accounts">
Doˆyouˆofferˆjointˆaccounts?ˆNo.ˆTallowbrookˆaccountsˆareˆindividualˆaccountsˆonly.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆjointˆaccounts,ˆandˆyouˆcan'tˆaddˆanˆauthorizedˆuserˆorˆaˆsecondˆcardˆholder.ˆ##ˆSharingˆmoneyˆwithˆaˆpartnerˆEachˆofˆyouˆcanˆopenˆyourˆownˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆandˆsendˆmoneyˆtoˆeachˆotherˆinstantlyˆwithˆBrookPay,ˆforˆfree.ˆ##ˆSharedˆgoalsˆSavingsˆPocketsˆbelongˆtoˆoneˆaccountˆandˆcan'tˆbeˆshared.ˆYouˆcanˆeachˆsaveˆtowardˆtheˆsameˆgoalˆinˆyourˆownˆpockets.ˆ##ˆManagingˆanˆaccountˆforˆsomeoneˆelseˆIfˆyouˆhaveˆpowerˆofˆattorney,ˆseeˆ"Powerˆofˆattorney".ˆOtherwise,ˆweˆcanˆonlyˆtalkˆtoˆtheˆaccountˆholder.ˆ##ˆWillˆyouˆofferˆjointˆaccounts?ˆWeˆdon'tˆhaveˆplansˆtoˆshareˆrightˆnow.ˆ##ˆCouplesˆandˆroommatesˆSplittingˆaˆbillˆisˆeasyˆwithˆBrookPay.ˆOneˆpersonˆpays,ˆandˆtheˆotherˆsendsˆtheirˆshareˆstraightˆfromˆtheˆapp.ˆBrookPayˆhasˆnoˆfeeˆandˆarrivesˆinˆseconds.ˆ##ˆMovingˆmoneyˆfromˆaˆjointˆaccountˆelsewhereˆYouˆcanˆlinkˆaˆjointˆaccountˆyouˆholdˆatˆanotherˆbankˆasˆanˆexternalˆaccount,ˆasˆlongˆasˆyourˆnameˆisˆonˆit.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
